How to deal with change?
</message>

<passage>
Blot out false imaginations, and say often to yourself:--It is now in my power to preserve my soul free from all wickedness, all lust, all confusion or disturbance. And then, as I truly discern the nature of things, I can use them all in due proportion. Be ever mindful of this power which Nature has given you.
</passage>

output.reason: Passage emphasizes inner stability amid external changes, relevant to handling change.
